tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Query durable, bounded service/browser/page/operation/recorder/tunnel events. Operation events retain full validated arguments, URLs and original error messages without redaction; filter component=operation for function call history. Survives instance closure and manager restart when the data volume is preserved. Only this principal and generic service events are visible. Logs require authentication and may contain credentials or input values in operation arguments. No arbitrary file access. Omit after_seq for recent events; use returned next_after_seq to read newer events.

tools.name: inspect_instance
tools.description: Inspect a live, busy, crashed or retained historical instance without taking its action lock. Returns exit/close reason, current operation and elapsed time, frame/encoder health, resource metrics and recent warnings. Optional bounded renderer probe does not cancel or retry actions. A timeout or SIGKILL alone does not prove OOM.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create an expiring public read-only viewer URL for one owned live instance or finalized recording. Anyone with this link can see its content without login; it grants no browser control or access to other resources. Returns URL once. Default 24 hours, maximum 30 days. Requires web mode.

tools.name: list_share_links
tools.description: List retained share metadata for this principal, including expiry and revocation status. Secret URLs are returned only at creation.

tools.name: revoke_share_link
tools.description: Revoke an owned public share link. Subsequent requests are denied and connected live viewers are disconnected within one second. Already downloaded content cannot be recalled.

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List retained recordings for this principal, optionally filtered by instance. Playback URLs require web login or the MCP Bearer token.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: List recent operation IDs and statuses for this principal after reconnect, including running actions. Does not expose arguments.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Query a recent operation after a transport timeout. Retained in daemon memory until restart or eviction (500 calls).

tools.name: put_artifact
tools.description: Store an authorized local file as base64, up to 512 KiB decoded per call. Returns artifact reference for upload_file.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Read service health and capacity.

tools.name: list_proxies
tools.description: List platform proxies with proxy_id, name, declared country, protocol, server, health status, latest check time/latency/error and authentication flag; no credentials. Checks run every 5 minutes by default. Use status=healthy for recent successful checks; a probe does not guarantee target-site access or country. Defaults to enabled only. Use proxy_id in create_instance, check_proxy or proxy_curl.

tools.name: proxy_curl
tools.description: Send one HTTP(S) request through a saved enabled proxy_id using curl, without a browser or shell. Supports methods, headers, UTF-8 body, bounded response and optional redirects. Returns HTTP status, response headers/body and elapsed time, including 4xx/5xx. No direct fallback; private destinations remain blocked unless enabled by the operator. No automatic retry; writes may succeed even when a timeout is returned. Output can contain destination secrets: handle appropriately.

tools.name: check_proxy
tools.description: Launch a temporary isolated browser through the selected proxy and query an IP endpoint; always cleans up. Does not assert country.

tools.name: create_instance
tools.description: Create an isolated Chromium instance with optional task_description (1–1000 characters, shown in console/history), UA, viewport and optional authenticated HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy. Use proxy_id from list_proxies, inline proxy, or legacy proxy_ref (mutually exclusive). No direct fallback. No proxy means explicit direct mode.

task_description.description: Task objective shown in the console and retained with instance history.

storage_state_id.description: Owner-authorized login state artifact from save_storage_state.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List live instances owned by this MCP principal.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Read instance configuration without proxy secrets.

tools.name: close_instance
tools.description: Close instance and all pages; artifacts survive until retention expiry.

tools.name: verify_environment
tools.description: Open temporary page through instance proxy to read actual IP response and device attributes. Default endpoint: api.ipify.org. Country requires independent verification.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a page inheriting instance proxy and device settings.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List live tabs with cached titles, URLs, active state, frames and pending dialogs, even while busy or unresponsive. Popups appear automatically.

tools.name: close_page
tools.description: Close a page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read cached tab metadata, frame IDs, load state, pending dialog and reload-required flag without taking the action lock. Closed tab data is retained until instance closure or tab-history eviction.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Select a live tab for browser focus, livestream and recording. Other operations still explicitly specify page_id.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Execute a JavaScript expression or function in this tab or frame. A function receives arg; promises are awaited. Returns a JSON value with bounded output. This can change page state. On timeout, execution is interrupted and the page must be reloaded before further writes; asynchronous effects may already have happened.

tools.name: read_element
tools.description: Read one element as structured data: text, value, attributes, checked/selected/disabled state and viewport bounding box. Use snapshot to refresh stale refs.

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.description: Query this tab network metadata, including successful fetch/XHR, navigation, redirects and failures. Captures start at page creation. Cursor advances on updates as well as new requests; merge by request_id. Per-tab history is bounded to 200 entries / 4 MiB. No browser action lock.

tools.name: get_network_request
tools.description: Read one captured request with raw request/response headers and optional bodies. Bodies are captured up to 256 KiB each; check body status, truncation and capture errors. Binary bodies use base64. Captured data is not redacted. Works while the instance is busy.

tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.description: Read original console text, location and page exceptions with stack traces for one tab, without the action lock. Includes log/info/warning/error, not just error categories. Bounded to 300 entries / 1 MiB; inspect truncated and dropped_entries.

tools.name: pointer
tools.description: Mouse operations in viewport CSS pixels: click, double_click, right_click, move, down, up, drag and wheel. Drag uses x/y to to_x/to_y; modifiers and mouse buttons supported. The active tab is selected for recording.

tools.name: keyboard
tools.description: Page-level keyboard press, key down/up or text insertion at the focused element. Supports combinations such as ControlOrMeta+A and Tab without locating an element.

tools.name: save_storage_state
tools.description: Save instance cookies, localStorage and optionally IndexedDB as a private owner-authorized artifact. Returns storage_state_id for create_instance or restore_storage_state. SessionStorage and browser extensions are not included.

tools.name: restore_storage_state
tools.description: Replace cookies and origin storage from an owned saved storage_state_id. Existing pages should be explicitly reloaded to use the restored login. New instances can instead pass storage_state_id to create_instance.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate, reload, back or forward. HTTP success is not a business pass.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Read accessible page tree and original-node element references. Refresh after changes. Optional frame CSS selects an iframe.

tools.name: interact
tools.description: Click/fill/press/select/check/hover/scroll using ref or exact role/name, text, CSS; optional frame CSS. Never blindly retry a timed-out write.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for one element state, URL glob or known download ID. No fixed sleeps.

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss a JavaScript dialog. Business authorization remains the caller responsibility.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture this tab, full page, one element or viewport clip. Returns the original PNG artifact plus an inline image preview in MCP. Preview dimensions may be scaled; pointer coordinates remain viewport CSS pixels.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Read bounded redacted navigation/HTTP errors, console categories and downloads for a live or disconnected instance even while busy. Use get_logs and inspect_instance for retained postmortem history. No response bodies or console strings are retained.

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: List downloads, status, errors and completed artifact metadata.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Read owner-authorized artifact as a bounded base64 chunk. Screenshots also return MCP image content when fetched completely.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a previously captured/downloaded owner-authorized artifact via a file input. Arbitrary server paths are forbidden.
